products.name: Razer Blade 14 (Ryzen AI 9 365, RTX 5060)
products.priceNote: Listed on razer.com; both configurations showed out of stock on the price date.
products.summary: Ultra-portable 14-inch gaming laptop with AMD Ryzen AI 9 365, GeForce RTX 50 Series graphics and a 3K 120 Hz OLED display.
products.description: Razer Blade 14 packs an AMD Ryzen AI 9 365 processor and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 or RTX 5070 graphics into a CNC-milled aluminum chassis about 16 mm thin and 1.63 kg. It has a 14-inch 2880x1800 120 Hz OLED display, per-key RGB keyboard, two USB4 ports with 100 W charging, HDMI 2.1 and a 72 Wh battery.
products.keywords: razer blade 14 oled gaming laptop amd ryzen ai rtx 5060 portable

specs.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 365 (10 cores / 20 threads, up to 5 GHz)
specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU 8 GB GDDR7 (100 W + 15 W Dynamic Boost)
specs.ports: 2x USB4 Type-C (PD, DP 2.1), 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen 2, HDMI 2.1, microSD (UHS-II), 3.5 mm

products.name: Razer BlackShark V3 Pro
products.summary: Wireless esports headset with hybrid ANC, 50 mm bio-cellulose drivers, detachable full-band mic and up to 70 hours of battery.
products.description: The Razer BlackShark V3 Pro uses TriForce Bio-Cellulose 50 mm Drivers Gen-2 and Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation. It connects over 2.4 GHz wireless, Bluetooth, USB wired or 3.5 mm, has a detachable HyperClear Full Band 12 mm mic, and lasts up to 70 hours on 2.4 GHz. Xbox and PlayStation versions are available.
products.keywords: razer blackshark v3 pro wireless anc esports headset

specs.connection: 2.4 GHz wireless, Bluetooth, USB wired, 3.5 mm
